visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a piece of glazed chicken held by wooden chopsticks. The chicken is glossy and dark brown, topped with fresh chopped green onions. The background is blurred, showing hints of more food. (2) Transition to an overhead view of a glass bowl containing raw deboned chicken thighs. Hands wearing clear plastic gloves enter the frame to add liquid ingredients like ketchup and oyster sauce. (3) The gloved hands thoroughly mix the chicken with the sauces and dry spices like sugar and white pepper. Text overlays appear at the top and bottom describing the ingredients and their weights. (4) A single piece of pale chicken skin is placed into a black non-stick frying pan using metal tongs. The skin sizzles and turns golden brown and crispy as it is fried. (5) Marinated chicken pieces are added to the hot pan. White cornstarch is sprinkled directly over the meat from a small glass container. The pieces are flipped to show a seared, caramelized exterior. (6) Minced ginger and sliced white onions are poured into the pan among the chicken pieces. They are stirred together using tongs to combine the aromatics. (7) Diced yellow pineapple chunks are added to the pan, followed by the remaining dark marinade from a bowl and a splash of water. A glass lid with a black handle is placed over the pan to simmer the mixture. (8) The lid is removed to show the bubbling sauce. Dark soy sauce is added for deeper color, along with additional onions, sliced red chilies, green onions, and fresh cilantro for the final garnish.
